hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/guidance/THINKING.md"; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; printf '%s\n' 'conclave plugin guidance' "Before any Agent call outside a /conclave:implement, /conclave:brainstorm, /conclave:investigate or /conclave:small-change run, read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/guidance/CLAUDE-ORCHESTRATION.md and follow it to the letter." "The roles named in that file and in the conclave skills (scout, researcher, diagnostician, dependency-analyzer, plan-verifier, security-reviewer, mech-executor, executor, security-executor, verifier) are this plugin's agents: pass conclave:<role> as the Agent tool's subagent_type. Explore is built in and keeps its bare name." ''; cat "$f"
